candidate_grammar.boundary: Every finite registered elementary chemical transition between distinct molecular states with complete conditions, positive completed-event count, positive tick count and positive observation support. External testing preserves all 46 rate rows from four complete declared NIST SRD 17 experimental records.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the literal product of carrier, state, event, recurrence, boundary, magnitude, prediction and extension forms.

excluded_inputs: no numerical zero; absent external coordinates are structural EmptyOne
no negative, irrational, imaginary, logarithmic, floating, signed or continuum SFT proof value
no imported mass-action equation, reaction order, Arrhenius form, fitted rate constant, concentration derivative or continuum time
no interpolation, regression, selection or target-derived correction
no target content before the complete identity and prediction seal
source-reported Arrhenius tabulations remain post-seal external records and are not raw event counts
intended_certificate: Complete 256-form census, one survivor, implementation-distinct reconstruction, depth-independent successor and complete post-seal 46-row NIST elementary-rate vector.
statement: An elementary chemical transition rate is the exact positive count of completed instances of one registered transition between distinct retained molecular states per positive reference tick and observation support, with conditions held and direction represented as a label.
title: Exact elementary-transition rate relation
